messages:
deploybot: :rocket: [staging] Initiating staging deploy by lina — tag `release/v2.1.0-rc6` commit `a1b2c3d` — change window 03:00-03:30 UTC — plan: canary(5%) -> half(40%) -> full
lina: starting canary 5% now. monitoring traces/5xx and tail latency.
marc: smoke: auth ok, embedding service slow warm-up (30s). posting logs -> `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=embedder -c server`
qa-ryan: canary smoke failing on reranker config mismatch: 400s from runtime due to new shard param. stack attached.
deploybot: Canary health failed (reranker) — automatic pause triggered. current traffic: 5%.
lina: ack. pinning release traffic back to stable if we can't patch within window. marc, can you confirm config mismatch?
marc: yes — config key `reranker.shard_count` not present in RC; new defaults assume 16 but infra set 8. quick patch to set env `RERANKER_SHARD_COUNT=8` in canary pods.
tony: pushing config patch as hotfix commit `b2c3d4e` and rolling canary subset.
ops-karen: preflight infra checks: scaling ok, ephemeral disk healthy. watch for OOMs.
qa-ryan: re-running smoke after patch.
marc: reranker smoke now passing, no 4xx. embedding warm-up improved.
lina: recommend resume -> next step to 40%. documenting decision: no rollback, hotfix applied to canary only, will include hotfix note in release draft.
deploybot: Traffic shifted to 40%. performing healthchecks (3m).
qa-ryan: half-wave smoke green. latency within expected variance.
ops-karen: monitoring single pod restart on g1-8, likely unrelated; no user impact.
lina: proceeding to 100%.
deploybot: :tada: Deploy finished to staging — status: success — tag `release/v2.1.0-rc6` (+hotfix `b2c3d4e`) — duration 13m — final traffic 100%.
marc: artefacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/staging/1717138000/ — logs + smoke reports.
qa-ryan: filing follow-up ticket INF-489 for config validation on future RCs.
lina: noted — will add a blurb to release notes: "v2.1.0-rc6 — applied reranker config compatibility patch during staging; no user-facing regressions observed."
ops-karen: adding infra check to next maintenance: validate `reranker.shard_count` default across images. :clipboard:
